convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with 'ColorJVariation' custom indicator (unknown implementation) and includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library. Entry/exit logic depends on custom indicator buffer values requiring manual Python reimplementation of the indicator.

derived_values.name: Value[0..2] - ColorJVariation buffer 0 values at SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, 0, SignalBar, 3, Value) → Value[0]=bar[SignalBar], Value[1]=bar[SignalBar+1], Value[2]=bar[SignalBar+2]

other_exits: Long position closed when sell signal detected (Value[1]>Value[2]) and BuyPosClose=true
Short position closed when buy signal detected (Value[1]<Value[2]) and SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM<0 → fixed lot size = abs(MM); MM>0 → deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic: Value[1]<Value[2] means indicator was declining (bullish setup), then Value[0]>Value[1] means indicator turned up (confirmation) → buy. Opposite for sell. The indicator is a JMA-smoothed variation of a moving average - needs ColorJVariation indicator source code to reimplement in Python. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen helpers and GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup. SignalBar=1 means signals read from the previous completed bar (not current forming bar).
backtest_data_needs: D1 730 days any symbol with 5-digit pricing
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement ColorJVariation indicator: it applies JMA smoothing (JLength=3, JPhase=100) to a variation series derived from MA (period=12, SMA). Entry: indicator declining across bars [2]→[1] then rising [1]→[0] = buy; rising then declining = sell. Exit via SL/TP or signal reversal. Position sizing: MM=-0.1 means fixed 0.1 lot; positive MM would be deposit fraction. The Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on data gaps.
